text:
With eyes closed

you light yourself from within

you are the blind stone

Night after night I carve you

with eyes closed

you are the open stone


We become immense

only by knowing each other

with eyes closed

translation.title: With Eyes Closed
translation.editorial_note: Franca is rendered as open, answering the earlier blind stone through availability rather than eyesight; carving and mutual knowledge occur without external vision.
